purpose: measures whether GradCAM saliency on the diagnosis classifier and 2 criterion heads (pigment_network, blue_whitish_veil) is faithful enough to ship as criterion-level visual evidence, via deletion/insertion AUC vs a random-order baseline (mean of 5 fixed random orders)
baseline: gaussian_blur (kernel ~ size/3, sigma = size/6, applied in normalised tensor space)
masking_space: preprocessed 224x224 tensor, patch-aligned to the ViT's own tokenisation
metric: P(originally-predicted class) on the SAME fitted head, re-encoded by the SAME frozen DermLIP
verdict: faithful: GradCAM beats random on both deletion and insertion for every head tested
